raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

In Mamba prefix-caching (`mamba_cache_mode="align"`) mode, intermediate prefill chunks end on the block grid. With the large blocks hybrid models get after page-size alignment, a sizeable part of `--max-num-batched-tokens` can silently stay idle on every prefill step. This PR warns at startup when that happens, suggests a block-aligned value, and documents the interaction. It does not change scheduling behavior.

## Claims

- `VllmConfig.validate_block_size()` now logs a warning when align-mode chunking would leave more than a quarter of the prefill budget idle. That method runs once the block size is final and already holds the align-mode constraints. The warning suggests the next block multiple plus decode headroom.
- The hybrid section of the automatic prefix caching guide explains how the token budget interacts with the block grid.
- For GLM-5.3-Flash on H100 64GB, setting the budget as the warning suggests improves 1/P90 (E2E seconds per output token) by 1.96× on a full agentic-coding trace replay (data below).

## Validation

**Unit tests** (CPU-only environment, upstream main `a9e90b9d` + this change):

```
pytest tests/test_config.py -k mamba_align
# 3 passed: the 2 new cases + existing test_validate_mamba_align_subblock_prefill
```

The full `tests/test_config.py` was run with and without this change in the same offline CPU environment. Both runs had the same 106 failures (tests that need the HF hub or a GPU) and 7 skips. Without the change, 339 tests passed. With it, 341 passed: the same tests plus the 2 new ones. No new failures.

`ruff check` and `ruff format` are clean.

**Why it matters: serving data** (GLM-5.3-Flash, vLLM 0.31.0, 2 × 4 H100 64GB, TP8 + EP, MTP k=3, `--max-model-len 1048576`, fp8 KV cache). Metric: 1/P90 of per-request (E2E s / output tokens), 16 concurrent sessions replaying two-turn agentic-coding traces with ~230K-token prompts. GLM-5.3-Flash serves with 1152-token blocks here, and the API-server default budget on GPUs below 70 GiB is 2048.

| `--max-num-batched-tokens` | prefill tokens / step | 1/P90 | TTFT P90 | vs 2048 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2048 (default) | 1152 | 3.47 (n=8) | 522 s | — |
| 3072 | 2304 | 5.52 | 318 s | +59% |
| 4096 | 3456 | 5.47 (n=5) | 318 s | +58% |
| 6144 | 5184 | 5.56 | 310 s | +60% |
| 8192 | 6912 | 5.23 (n=4) | 335 s | +51% |

- The 3072–8192 rows also set `--max-cudagraph-capture-size 128 --language-model-only`. Those two flags alone gave +2% (3.53, n=2).
- 12288 and 16384 no longer leave enough KV cache for a 1M context on 64 GB GPUs.
- In a full trace-replay run (C16, 3600 s + 1800 s grace, seed 42; 238 / 353 profiled requests), 4096 vs 2048 measured 1/P90 0.642 vs 0.327 (**1.96×**) and TTFT P90 233.6 s vs 442.6 s. Both arms had 0 errors and passed the same output-quality checks.

This serving data was collected on vLLM 0.31.0, setting the flag by hand. The warning itself is verified by the unit test; it was not exercised in a GPU server run on main.

## Details

- **Root cause:** `Scheduler._mamba_block_aligned_split` floors intermediate chunk ends to `block_size` so the cached SSM state stays block-aligned. A long prompt therefore prefills `floor(budget / block) * block` tokens per step, and decode tokens in the same step can lower this further. With 1152-token blocks and a 2048 budget, 44% of the budget goes unused, and nothing in the logs says so.
- **Why warn instead of auto-adjusting:** the final hybrid block size is only known after the workers align it with the Mamba page size. By then workers have already sized buffers from `max_num_batched_tokens` (profiling run, CUDA graph and compile ranges, backend workspaces), so raising the budget at that point would be unsafe.
- **Scope:**
  - The check is skipped when `--long-prefill-token-threshold` is set, because the user is then deliberately tuning chunk sizes.
  - It is also skipped when the block is larger than the budget. In that case the existing sub-block path keeps chunks running, so the budget is not idled.
  - The 25% threshold keeps it quiet for the 80 GB defaults: 8192 with 1152-token blocks keeps 6912 tokens, 84% of the budget.
- **Related open PRs:** #54076, #61845, #50409 and #57605 change where align-mode chunks end. None of them surfaces or documents the idle budget, so this is not a duplicate. If #54076 lands, this check should read the same block size as the split. Today both read `cache_config.block_size`.

@@ -34,6 +34,10 @@ vllm serve <hybrid-model> \
 
 Choose a value that divides the block size of every prefix-cacheable KV cache group, and that is a multiple of the per-state compression ratio for models that use one, such as sparse MLA. vLLM validates both at startup and names the offending sizes in the error. Read the served block size from the startup log. 64 is a reasonable starting point.
 
+### Prefill token budget
+
+With prefix caching, intermediate prefill chunks of a long prompt also end on the Mamba block grid. Each step prefills the largest block multiple that fits the token budget, and the remainder stays idle. Hybrid models often use large blocks: with a 1152-token block, a 2048-token `--max-num-batched-tokens` (the API server default on GPUs below 70 GiB) prefills only 1152 tokens per step. Set `--max-num-batched-tokens` to a multiple of the block size plus headroom for the decode tokens scheduled in the same step. vLLM logs a warning at startup when more than a quarter of the budget would stay idle.
+
 ## Example workloads
 
 We describe two example workloads, where APC can provide huge performance benefit:

@@ -3176,6 +3176,34 @@ def test_validate_mamba_align_subblock_prefill():
     VllmConfig.validate_block_size(config)
 
 
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("max_num_batched_tokens", "expect_warning"), [(2048, True), (4096, False)]
+)
+def test_validate_mamba_align_warns_on_idle_prefill_budget(
+    caplog_vllm, max_num_batched_tokens: int, expect_warning: bool
+):
+    """Align-mode chunks end on the block grid: a 1152-token block caps a
+    2048-token budget at 1152 prefill tokens per step, while 4096 keeps 3456."""
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(block_size=1152, mamba_cache_mode="align"),
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(decode_context_parallel_size=1),
+        scheduler_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            max_num_batched_tokens=max_num_batched_tokens,
+            max_num_scheduled_tokens=max_num_batched_tokens,
+            long_prefill_token_threshold=0,
+            max_num_seqs=256,
+            disable_chunked_mm_input=False,
+        ),
+        kv_transfer_config=None,
+        num_speculative_tokens=3,
+    )
+
+    VllmConfig.validate_block_size(config)
+
+    warned = "prefills at most 1152 of the 2048-token budget" in caplog_vllm.text
+    assert warned == expect_warning
+
+
 @pytest.mark.parametrize(
     ("model_id", "compilation_config", "optimization_level"),
     [

@@ -3320,6 +3320,28 @@ def validate_block_size(self) -> None:
                 "to schedule a multiple of block_size tokens even if they are "
                 "in the middle of a mm input"
             )
+            # Intermediate prefill chunks end on the block grid, so a long
+            # prompt prefills only the largest block multiple of the budget.
+            sched = self.scheduler_config
+            if sched.long_prefill_token_threshold == 0:
+                budget = sched.max_num_scheduled_tokens or sched.max_num_batched_tokens
+                usable = budget // block_size * block_size
+                if block_size <= budget and usable < 0.75 * budget:
+                    decode_tokens = sched.max_num_seqs * (
+                        1 + self.num_speculative_tokens
+                    )
+                    logger.warning(
+                        "Mamba prefix caching ends intermediate prefill chunks "
+                        "on the %d-token block grid, so a long prompt prefills "
+                        "at most %d of the %d-token budget per step. Set "
+                        "--max-num-batched-tokens to a multiple of %d plus "
+                        "decode headroom (e.g. %d) to use it fully.",
+                        block_size,
+                        usable,
+                        budget,
+                        block_size,
+                        usable + block_size + decode_tokens,
+                    )
 
     @model_validator(mode="after")
     def validate_nvfp4_kv_cache_with_mla(self) -> "VllmConfig":
